name: Custom Post Type
description: Adds a Custom Post Type class extending Abstract_Post_Type from rtcamp/wp-php-toolkit. Always multi-instance (one class per post type).

inputs.description: PSR-4 namespace for the post type class. Default 'Inc\PostTypes' matches the rtCamp skeleton; pass the project's actual sub-namespace (e.g. 'Acme\Blog\PostTypes') to override.
Directory for the post type file. Default 'includes/PostTypes' matches the rtCamp skeleton; pass the project's actual sub-path to override.
PSR-4 namespace for the test class. Default 'Inc\Tests\PostTypes' matches the rtCamp skeleton; override alongside 'namespace' for non-default projects.
Directory for the test file. Default 'tests/PostTypes'.
Post type slug (kebab-case, used as the key in register_post_type(), e.g. 'product').
PascalCase class name, derived from slug.

wiring.description: Instantiate the post type so it registers its init hook. Post types are always multi-instance (each instance carries the configuration for one post type). Insert in the plugin bootstrap alongside other post type registrations.
